records.jp: や、やった……
records.en_original: W-we did it...
records.en_auxiliary: W-we did it...
records.en: W-we did it...

records.jp: わっ！？　なにこれ！？
records.en_original: Whoa?! What's that!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa?! What's that!
records.en: Whoa?! What's this?!

records.jp: 記憶の欠片……とは違うみたい
records.en_original: It seems different from those memory fragments...
records.en_auxiliary: It seems different from those memory fragments...
records.en: It seems different from those memory fragments...

records.jp: これ以上奥の部屋はないし、大事なものだと<CR>思うんだけど……
records.en_original: I think this is the end. It must be important.
records.en_auxiliary: I think this is the end. It must be important.
records.en: There are no rooms farther in,<CR>so I think it must be important...

records.jp: わ、なんだ？
records.en_original: Ah! What was that?
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! What was that?
records.en: Whoa, what was that?

records.jp: ここまでたどり着いたキミたちに耳寄り情報♪
records.en_original: Good work making it this far! I've got some lovely news for you adventurers!
records.en_auxiliary: Good work making it this far! I've got some lovely news for you adventurers!
records.en: A hot tip for all of you who made it this far♪

records.jp: ふざけてるの？
records.en_original: Are you messing with us?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you messing with us?
records.en: Are you messing with us?

records.jp: 冷たいなあ……悲しい！
records.en_original: Oh, your words! How they wound me!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, your words! How they wound me!
records.en: So cold... How sad!

records.jp: 耳寄り情報って何ー？
records.en_original: So what's the news?
records.en_auxiliary: So what's the news?
records.en: What's the hot tip?

records.jp: よくぞ聞いてくれました！
records.en_original: Thank you for asking!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you for asking!
records.en: Thank you for asking!

records.jp: もう気付いていると思うけど、この世界は<CR>靭こころさんの想いを核にして作られているんだ！
records.en_original: I'm sure you've noticed by now, but this world is created from Ms. Kokoro Utsubo's feelings and memories!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure you've noticed by now, but this world is created from Ms. Kokoro Utsubo's feelings and memories!
records.en: I think you've already realized this, but this world<CR>was created around Utsubo Kokoro-san's feelings!

records.jp: そして、今キミたちの前にあるそれこそが、<CR>靭こころさんの想いの結晶―――
records.en_original: In front of you now, is a crystal made from Kokoro's memories.
records.en_auxiliary: In front of you now, is a crystal made from Kokoro's memories.
records.en: And what lies before you now<CR>is the crystallization of Utsubo Kokoro-san's feelings—

records.jp: フラグメントだよ☆
records.en_original: Behold, a Fragment!
records.en_auxiliary: Behold, a Fragment!
records.en: A Fragment☆

records.jp: どうすればいいの？
records.en_original: What do I do with it?
records.en_auxiliary: What do I do with it?
records.en: What do I do with it?

records.jp: 手をかざして、フラグメントが放つ想いを受け入れて！<CR>きっとキミたちが求めていたものが手に入るよ☆
records.en_original: Hold out your hand and recover your lost memories! I'm sure it'll help you find what you're all seeking!
records.en_auxiliary: Hold out your hand and recover your lost memories! I'm sure it'll help you find what you're all seeking!
records.en: Hold out your hand and accept the feelings radiating from the Fragment!<CR>I'm sure you'll obtain what you've been seeking☆

records.jp: ちょっと前までこの世界に入るなーって言ってたくせに
records.en_original: Weren't you the one who told us not to come in here?
records.en_auxiliary: Weren't you the one who told us not to come in here?
records.en: Weren't you the one who told us not to come in here?

records.jp: その方が良いと思ってたからね☆<CR>でも、考えを改めたよ
records.en_original: That's cause I thought it was better that way, but I've reconsidered!
records.en_auxiliary: That's cause I thought it was better that way, but I've reconsidered!
records.en: Because I thought that was for the best☆<CR>But I've changed my mind.

records.jp: キミたちにはいろいろな世界に行ってもらった方が<CR>良いのかもしれないって
records.en_original: It may actually be better if you went to lots of different worlds.
records.en_auxiliary: It may actually be better if you went to lots of different worlds.
records.en: Maybe it would be better<CR>for all of you to visit all sorts of worlds.

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What is that suppose to mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What is that suppose to mean?
records.en: What is that supposed to mean?

records.jp: それはここでの暮らしに関係ないから、<CR>答えられないよ！
records.en_original: As that has nothing to do with living here, I'm afraid I can't answer that!
records.en_auxiliary: As that has nothing to do with living here, I'm afraid I can't answer that!
records.en: That has nothing to do with your life here,<CR>so I can't answer!

records.jp: うざ
records.en_original: You're a pain...
records.en_auxiliary: You're a pain...
records.en: So annoying.

records.jp: 手をかざして、想いを受け入れる……
records.en_original: Hold out my hand, and recover my memories...
records.en_auxiliary: Hold out my hand, and recover my memories...
records.en: Hold out my hand and accept the feelings...

records.jp: リフナビの言うことを信じるなら、<CR>それで求めていたものが手に入る
records.en_original: If we're to believe what ReSource said, this will help us find what we're looking for.
records.en_auxiliary: If we're to believe what ReSource said, this will help us find what we're looking for.
records.en: If we believe ReSource,<CR>that will give us what we've been seeking.

records.jp: 記憶を……取り戻せる？
records.en_original: She can get her memories back?
records.en_auxiliary: She can get her memories back?
records.en: Can I... get my memories back?

records.jp: こころ
records.en_original: Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro?
records.en: Kokoro.

records.jp: うん、やってみる
records.en_original: I'll try it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll try it.
records.en: Yeah. I'll try.

records.jp: どこに行ったって、<CR>わたしたちはずっと友達。そうでしょ？
records.en_original: No matter where I go, we'll always be friends. Right?
records.en_auxiliary: No matter where I go, we'll always be friends. Right?
records.en: No matter where we go,<CR>we'll always be friends. Right?

records.jp: うんっ……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: もっと周りを頼って……他の友達も作るんですよ！
records.en_original: But you need to make more friends! Rely on other people a little.
records.en_auxiliary: But you need to make more friends! Rely on other people a little.
records.en: Rely on the people around you more... and make other friends too!

records.jp: 周りを、頼る……
records.en_original: Rely on others...
records.en_auxiliary: Rely on others...
records.en: Rely on others...

records.jp: ……分かった。わたし、変わるよ
records.en_original: Okay. I'm going to change.
records.en_auxiliary: Okay. I'm going to change.
records.en: Okay. I'm going to change.

records.jp: 人を頼れるようになる。それに、<CR>もし同じように困ってる人がいたら――
records.en_original: I'll learn to rely on others. And if I ever meet someone in trouble like I was...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll learn to rely on others. And if I ever meet someone in trouble like I was...
records.en: I'll learn to rely on others.<CR>And if I ever meet someone in trouble like I was—

records.jp: 今度はわたしが、手を差し伸べてあげられるように
records.en_original: I'll help them as best I can.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll help them as best I can.
records.en: This time, I want to be the one who can reach out to them.

records.jp: うん、それがいいと思います！
records.en_original: That sounds wonderful, Kokoro!
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds wonderful, Kokoro!
records.en: Yeah, I think that's a wonderful idea!

records.jp: どれだけ離れても、ずっと、ずっと……<CR>詩帆ちゃんの友達だからっ！
records.en_original: It doesn't matter how far apart we are, we'll be friends forever, Shiho!
records.en_auxiliary: It doesn't matter how far apart we are, we'll be friends forever, Shiho!
records.en: No matter how far apart we are, I'll always, always...<CR>be your friend, Shiho-chan!

records.jp: フラグメントの再接続を確認しました。<CR>世界構築の安定性低下に注意してください
records.en_original: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragment reconnection confirmed. Caution: Stability of world structure deteriorating.
records.en: Fragment reconnection confirmed.<CR>Caution: world-construction stability is decreasing.

records.jp: まぶしっ――
records.en_original: So bright—
records.en_auxiliary: So bright—
records.en: So bright—

records.jp: 詩帆――春日、詩帆。<CR>わたしの特別な、友達の名前
records.en_original: Her name was Shiho... Shiho Kasuga. She was very special to me...
records.en_auxiliary: Her name was Shiho... Shiho Kasuga. She was very special to me...
records.en: Shiho—Kasuga Shiho.<CR>The name of my special friend.

records.jp: やっと、思い出せた――
records.en_original: I finally remember...
records.en_auxiliary: I finally remember...
records.en: I finally remember...

records.jp: お、終わった……？
records.en_original: I-it's over?
records.en_auxiliary: I-it's over?
records.en: I-it's over?

records.jp: どう、こころ？<CR>記憶、取り戻せた？
records.en_original: Are your memories back?
records.en_auxiliary: Are your memories back?
records.en: So, Kokoro?<CR>Did you recover your memories?

records.jp: ……わたしは詩帆ちゃんに、<CR>周りを頼ることの大切さを教えてもらった
records.en_original: Shiho taught me how important it is to rely on the people around me.
records.en_auxiliary: Shiho taught me how important it is to rely on the people around me.
records.en: Shiho-chan taught me how important it is<CR>to rely on the people around me.

records.jp: そして、わたしも詩帆ちゃんみたいに<CR>誰かの助けになりたいと思った
records.en_original: I wanted to become more like her, and help others.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanted to become more like her, and help others.
records.en: And I decided I wanted to help someone<CR>the way Shiho-chan had helped me.

records.jp: だから、わたしは――リフレクターになった
records.en_original: So I became a Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: So I became a Reflector.
records.en: So I became a Reflector.

records.jp: えっ、リフレクターに……？
records.en_original: A Reflector...?
records.en_auxiliary: A Reflector...?
records.en: You became a Reflector...?

records.jp: うん。いろいろ思い出したよ、<CR>“元の世界”のこと。でも――
records.en_original: Yes. I remember a lot of things. Including about the world we call home. But before that—
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I remember a lot of things. Including about the world we call home. But before that—
records.en: Yeah. I remembered all kinds of things<CR>about the original world. But—

records.jp: まずはここから出る、かな？
records.en_original: We should get out of here, right?
records.en_auxiliary: We should get out of here, right?
records.en: First we should get out of here, right?

records.jp: そうだね。<CR>……みんな、協力してくれてありがとう
records.en_original: Exactly. Thank you for your help everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly. Thank you for your help everyone.
records.en: Yeah.<CR>...Everyone, thank you for helping me.

records.jp: 気にしなくていいよ。<CR>友達なんだから
records.en_original: Don't worry about it! We're friends.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about it! We're friends.
records.en: Don't worry about it.<CR>We're friends.

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 詩帆ちゃん、わたし……変わったよ。<CR>詩帆ちゃんは今、どこで何をしてるのかな
records.en_original: I've changed, Shiho... I wonder where you are now.
records.en_auxiliary: I've changed, Shiho... I wonder where you are now.
records.en: Shiho-chan, I've... changed.<CR>I wonder where you are and what you're doing now.

records.jp: また、会えたらいいな……
records.en_original: I wish I could see you again...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I could see you again...
records.en: I wish I could see you again...

records.jp: （特別な友達、か……）
records.en_original: (Someone special, huh...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Someone special, huh...)
records.en: (Someone special, huh...)

records.jp: （きっとこころは『特別』を取り戻していて、<CR>私には見えない世界が見えている）
records.en_original: (Seems like Kokoro has recovered something very special to her. I wonder what it's like.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Seems like Kokoro has recovered something very special to her. I wonder what it's like.)
records.en: (Kokoro has surely recovered something 'special,'<CR>and she can see a world I can't.)

records.jp: どうしたの、愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: Something the matter, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Something the matter, Ao?
records.en: What's wrong, Ao-chan?

records.jp: ん？　んーん、なんでもないよ
records.en_original: Mm? Oh, nothing...
records.en_auxiliary: Mm? Oh, nothing...
records.en: Mm? Oh, nothing...

records.jp: （……私にもそういう思い出、<CR>何かあったっけなぁ……――）
records.en_original: (Do I have any memories like that?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Do I have any memories like that?)
records.en: (...Did I have any memories like that too...<CR>I wonder...—)
